reports.title: Rivian Releases Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Annual Guidance Summary
section: •Full year delivery guidance is improving from 65,000 - 70,000 units to 67,000 - 70,000 units as a result of the production and delivery outlook for the fourth quarter of 2026.

•Adjusted EBITDA is improving by $100 million at the mid-point due to better than expected revenue related to regulatory credits, an IEEPA tariff refund receivable in the third quarter, and an expected increase in delivery volumes.
•Capital Expenditures are decreasing by $300 million at the mid-point due to timing of spend.

Vehicles Delivered | 67,000 – 70,000
Adjusted EBITDA | $(1.85)B – $(1.75)B
Capital Expenditures | $1.40B – $1.50B
